Both fetched 2026-08-22. Diffing the two lists by name, most of the gap is naming variants for the same programme ('Applied Math' vs 'Applied Mathematics', 'Germanic Languages and Literature' vs '...Literatures', 'Romance Languages and Literature' vs '...Literatures', 'Slavic Literatures and Cultures' vs 'Slavic Languages and Literatures', 'Theater, Dance & Media' vs 'Theater, Dance, & Media'), plus the engineering renaming above, plus 'Special Concentrations' and 'Energy, Climate, and the Environment' which appear only in the API, and 'Human Evolutionary Biology' (College page) vs 'Human Biology, Behavior, and Evolution' (API), which may be a rename and has NOT been treated as confirmed either way.
